mapper.select: SELECT student_no ,class_id ,student_class_no ,member_id ,student_email ,student_name ,birthday ,student_img ,student_sex ,remark ,allergy FROM student_manage WHERE class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY student_class_no

SELECT student_no, class_id, student_class_no, member_id, student_email, student_name, birthday, student_img, student_sex, CASE WHEN remark = 'G101' THEN '다문화가정' WHEN remark = 'G102' THEN '한부모가정' WHEN remark = 'G103' THEN '조부모가정' WHEN remark = 'G104' THEN '기초생활수급자' WHEN remark = 'G105' THEN '차상위계층' WHEN remark = 'G106' THEN '해당없음' ELSE '해당없음' END AS remark, LISTAGG(sub_cd_nm, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sub_cd_nm) AS allergy FROM student_manage LEFT JOIN sub_cd ON INSTR(allergy, sub_cd) > 0 WHERE student_no = #{studentNo} GROUP BY student_no, class_id, student_class_no, member_id, student_email, student_name, birthday, student_img, student_sex, remark
SELECT member_id , student_name FROM student_manage WHERE class_id = #{classId}
